disposition.note: Operation paths, record members, approval instant and kind values stated as assumptions; state mapping marked not specified; file column set left to the wave 4 freeze.

edits.old: fails or does not answer within the 2 s budget of the gateway-bff route
edits.new: fails or does not answer within its 2 s client budget

edits.old: When a run asks for the level of a step while that call is in that state
edits.new: When the operation or run that needs the answer of that call makes it

edits.old: Then the run resolves no level and writes no record, and the failure is returned in the platform error envelope
edits.new: Then the failure is returned in the platform error envelope and no value is assumed in place of the missing answer

edits.old: and the approval reference is a named member of the same jsonb, carried as approval_ref and added as a backward-compatible column whose migration number
edits.new: and until its column is added the approval reference is a named member of the same jsonb; it is carried as approval_ref and added as a backward-compatible column whose migration number

edits.old: The approval answer's element names and the file column set are settled at the wave 4 contract freeze.
edits.new: The approval answer's element names and the file column set are settled at the wave 4 contract freeze. The right of the change is rwb-access's and is not declared by this contract (BR8). The state mapping is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0637).

findings.issue: AC8 fails level resolution on a remote call, but the run path has no synchronous read for the level. It also ties the 2 s client budget to the gateway-bff route.
The assumptions say the approval reference is a jsonb member and also an added column, without saying how the two relate.
The state mapping named by GAP-0637 is neither settled nor marked as not specified. The note also cites message texts the story does not mention.
The right of the change, named by GAP-0636 and GAP-0640, is not addressed in the added assumptions.
